question: Who among these is known as the father of Indian Railways?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Dalhousie**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Dalhousie** is known as the father of Indian Railways.
 
• Indian Railways was founded on 16 April 1853.
 
• The Headquarters of the Indian Railway is in New Delhi.
 
• John Mathai presented the first Railway Budget for independent India in November 1947. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Up to 2016, a separate Railway Budget was prepared.** Suresh Prabhu was the last Railway minister to propose the Railway Budget in the year 2016**__ after which the Railway Budget was merged with the Union Budget.
